source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 13ης Μαΐου — «Άγιος Αββανός»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. **The display name is the page's own form transliterated and nothing more**: saint.gr writes «Αββανός» and gives him no epithet, no see and no Latin form, so no Irish or English spelling is supplied here. **`preacher` is the only `types` entry** because preaching the word of God at Abingdon is the only thing the page says he did; it does not call him monk, bishop or abbot, and «Κοιμήθηκε οσίως με ειρήνη» is not an office. **The `dates` object holds only the century the page states**, with the baptism year in its note; the page gives no birth or death year. **Nothing in the corpus reads as him**: the namesweep printed no row for the name.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).
